title: Object and Array Creation Patterns
ques: Demonstrate modern patterns for creating Objects and Arrays in JavaScript: object literals with computed property names, shorthand notation, and array factory methods.
explanation: Object literals allow concise property shorthands, computed property keys (`[key]`), and method definitions. Array helper methods create initialized sequences cleanly.

title: Essential Array and Object Methods
ques: Demonstrate higher-order array methods (**`map`**, **`filter`**, and **`reduce`**) and static Object utilities (**`Object.keys`**, **`Object.values`**, **`Object.entries`**).
explanation: `filter`, `map`, and `reduce` form the foundation of functional data transformation in JavaScript. `Object.entries` produces `[key, value]` pairs for clean iteration.

title: Destructuring Arrays and Objects
ques: Explain the mechanics of **Object and Array Destructuring**. Show default values, property renaming, and rest syntax (`...rest`).
explanation: Destructuring extracts values from arrays or properties from objects into distinct variables in a single expressive statement, supporting default fallbacks and rest gathering.
